# requireVersionCompatible

<link-summary>Returns the version once it is known to meet the requirement, or throws.</link-summary>

<web-summary>requireVersionCompatible() — Returns the version once it is known to meet the requirement, or throws. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>lang/string</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function requireVersionCompatible(
  currentVersion: string,
  requiredVersion: string,
  message?: string
): string;
```

The assertion form. The default message names both versions, which is what makes an unmet dependency readable in an execution log.

## Parameters

| Parameter              | Type     | Description                                                                        |
| :--------------------- | :------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `currentVersion`       | `string` | The version in hand.                                                               |
| `requiredVersion`      | `string` | The minimum that is acceptable.                                                    |
| `message` _(optional)_ | `string` | The message of the exception. A default naming both versions is used when omitted. |

## Returns

`string` — the current version, unchanged.

## Throws

| Exception                  | Condition                                   |
| :------------------------- | :------------------------------------------ |
| `IllegalArgumentException` | the current version is lower than required. |

## Examples

### Guarding a dependency

```javascript
requireVersionCompatible("1.3.0", "1.2.0"); // => "1.3.0"
```
